reviewNotes: Twenty-five delivery confirmations and character-specific request-board strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover placeholders, leading and trailing spaces, dialogue tokens, the literal heart marker, gender and option delimiters, signatures, distinct character voices, punctuation, and natural Romanian; both found no remaining objective issue.
